Package com.recruitment.service

Class AIAnalysisService

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.service.AIAnalysisService
public class AIAnalysisService extends Object
Stateless analysis service for skill matching and TA workload balancing.

Performs rule-based scoring over in-memory User, Job, and Application data supplied by callers. Optionally enriches top results with narrative comments from the DeepSeek API when enabled in AppConfig.

This service does not persist data; it reads from other services and returns analysis DTOs (AIAnalysisService.CandidateAnalysis, AIAnalysisService.WorkloadAnalysisResult, etc.).

  • Method Details

    • analyzeJobApplicants

      public List<AIAnalysisService.CandidateAnalysis> analyzeJobApplicants(Job job, List<Application> applications, UserService userService)
      Analyses skill match between applicants and a job's required skills.

      Results are sorted by match percentage descending. When DeepSeek is enabled, the top three candidates receive an AIAnalysisService.CandidateAnalysis.aiComment.

      Parameters:
      job - the job posting (required skills taken from Job.getRequiredSkills())
      applications - applications to evaluate (typically for this job)
      userService - used to resolve applicant User profiles
      Returns:
      sorted list of AIAnalysisService.CandidateAnalysis; skips applications whose applicant is unknown

    • exportAnalysisToText

      public String exportAnalysisToText(Job job, List<AIAnalysisService.CandidateAnalysis> results)

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • analyzeWorkload

      public AIAnalysisService.WorkloadAnalysisResult analyzeWorkload(List<User> tas, ApplicationService appService, JobService jobService)
      Analyses TA workload distribution and generates rebalancing suggestions.

      Workload score is accepted × 3 + pending × 1. TAs are classified as Overloaded, Balanced, or Available relative to the average ± 30%. When DeepSeek is enabled, AIAnalysisService.WorkloadAnalysisResult.aiComment is populated.

      Parameters:
      tas - list of TA users to analyse
      appService - source of application counts per TA
      jobService - used to resolve job details for suggestions
      Returns:
      aggregate AIAnalysisService.WorkloadAnalysisResult with metrics, suggestions, and summary
